title: NOVOO 140W GaN III USB-C Charger (3x USB-C, 1x USB-A) $58.99 + Delivery ($0 with Prime / $59 Spend) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: NOVOO 140W GaN III USB-C Charger (3x USB-C, 1x USB-A) $58.99 + Delivery ($0 with Prime / $59 Spend) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU

[Dishcount] Can't see a post on this model so this is ATL I think.
Checked on CCC , confirmed this is ATL
[techno2000] C3 and A distribution is sad.
7.5w + 7.5w in many scenarios.
I dont know why many power bricks are like this.
At least give 10w minimum,
[Some Random Guy] I wish they were tuneable as I don't like dumping power into a phone as it'll heat the battery more.
7.5W is good for my use cases but i see how it can be a pity
[azukay] Power bricks aren't smart devices beside a basic negotiation chip, that's what the phone itself does, on my Samsung I literally use routines and set phone to normal slow charge and max charge of 80 percent during hours I sleep and set it back to fast charge and 95 percent max charge 30 minutes before my wake time.
[4ustralia] ATL thanks was waiting for 140w to come down
[Lordeee] Are these like other gan chargers where if you plug another device in, it like stops charging then recharges again?
[JimmyJohnO] In my experience, unless the description says so, they almost always turn off and on again to renegotiate power.
[whyisave] Wow…I didn't know that 'renegotiation' was actually how GaN chargers worked.
About 6 months ago, I bought a GaN charger, and took it traveling.
Every now and then, I would use the USB-A slot (with USB-C at times, too), and then I noticed the power always cutting out, and coming back again.
I thought the charger couldn't handle USB-A and USB-C together, so I only used USB-A at times…and even then, the power used to cut out more frequently, than the only just USB-C slots.
I concluded that the charger itself was "faulty", and that was just my luck-of-the-draw.
[Wilburre] Vast majority do that as part of USB C negotiation. Some such as Ugreen 200w don't at least on the 2 100w ports. I know that because I use one to dock my switch 2 in bed and charge phone etc
[azukay] I use a slimq 150w charger, that one don't need to renegotiate when new devices are plugged in, but it's double the price when on sale, but it has a better power profile on the ports. Quality can be hit and miss I had 1 unit that died 8 months after purchase they replaced under warranty. While my second unit is used constantly at 95 watts to charge my legion go 2 and provides power to an USB weather machine at the same time without any problems
[EssendonUser] Picked up a couple of these earlier. Feel super sturdy and well-built with a bit of weight to them. Definitely worth it.
[GenerallyClumsy] Such a great price although I'm not a fan of the hardwired plugs.
[Wilburre] Can't speak to this one but I have their 67w, the tiny 100w and the 120w that is in the same format as this 140w and they've all been good. No heating up and construction feels quality. I've never stressed them though as my laptop only pulls 65w.
[aub] Question: can this do 20V pd on one port and 12V pd on another simultaneously?
[Kinjiru] Noob question: on the page it shows that USB-C1 can charge 65W max, USB-C2 30W, and then the remaning 2 ports 7.5W each. If I plug in 4 devices that equals 110W doesn't it? Where does the 140W come from?
Nevermind: In clicking on other tabs, I can see that if you only plug in 1 device, it can get up to 140W on USB-C1.
[oz-dave] You can only get 140W from the first USB-C port when it is the sole port in use.
Edit: Can see you worked it out ;-)
[vid_ghost] Thanks OP grabbed one. At this price for a Gan 3 charger its a no brainier.
[GreenRomeo] I remember there were some reviews of NOVOO chargers and some were really good and some were not so good. I think the 67W and 120W are in the good list. Not sure about this one though.
[vid_ghost] NOVOO 67W Great and delivers a stable 67w+ power
NOVOO 100W Good but not a true 24/7 100w charger
NOVOO 120W Its just ok and again not a 24/7 stable 120w charger
NOVOO 140W Stress Tests & Community Feedback: Most users on Reddit agree that the charger sustains high wattage outputs over extended periods without major thermal stress or permanent throttling.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=48rVf1onPkM
[AdamFury] I have charger fatigue but gee this is tempting.
[I Smell Pennies] You might also win one during the night 😝
[whyisave] You get a NOVOO,…
and You get a NOVOO,…
so do you,…You get a NOVOO,…
